mechanism: Liquidation cascade: 60-minute spot return and 60-minute USD-M open-interest change both at or below their trailing-30-day 0.5th percentile (thresholds fixed per UTC day) -> long spot for 4 hours, 10 coins
orthogonality: Bets on forced-seller exhaustion within hours of a long liquidation cascade, a state the closed survivors never traded. Intraday version of v57: cascades last minutes to hours, which daily bars dilute.
weekend_coverage: Binance spot klines and USD-M metrics are 24/7; no signal vacuum. Missing metrics files suppress triggers.
knowledge_disclosure: Designed after v57 (daily deleveraging rebound, same family) was opened on 2022-2023 and missed on p (0.105) with 2023 negative, and after the cost study. Only 2025 BTC 1m move sizes were looked at (ADR-018), no strategy PnL. The 2024-2025 confirmation is binding; per W3 a development pass alone means little.
cost_napkin: Two fills of 12 bps per trade: 0.24% per 4-hour hold; the median 4-hour BTC move in 2025 was 0.41%.
semantics: Per symbol, a full 1-minute UTC grid from the first to the last spot kline; close is the spot close of that minute, NaN if the minute is missing (no fill).
r60[t] = close[t] / close[t-60] - 1 on grid rows; NaN if either is missing.

Row t is decided at T = t + 1 minute. oi_asof(x) = open_interest of the last metrics observation stamped <= x; NaN if that stamp is older than x - oi_max_staleness_minutes or the value is missing or <= 0. doi60[t] = oi_asof(T) / oi_asof(T - 60 minutes) - 1.

Thresholds for UTC day D: numpy linear quantile(quantile) of the finite r60 values and, separately, of the finite doi60 values on rows in [D - baseline_days, D). If either series has fewer than min_baseline_fraction x baseline_days x 1440 finite values there, no trigger on day D.
Trigger at row t in day D: r60[t] <= r60 threshold(D) and doi60[t] <= doi60 threshold(D), both finite.
Hold: a trigger at t sets weight_per_symbol on rows t .. t + hold_minutes - 1; triggers inside an open hold are ignored; the next trigger may fire from row t + hold_minutes.
Output: weights on the union minute grid, one column per symbol, 0 elsewhere, no NaN, sum of absolute weights <= 1.
limitations: Spot fills at the minute close one bar after the decision (ADR-018 2.3); slippage only through the cost scenarios. Open interest is the perp market's; the trade is spot.
